source_caption:
🎬 The Good Lie (2014)

The Good Lie follows a group of Sudanese refugees who survive the devastating civil war in their homeland and spend years living in a refugee camp before receiving an opportunity to start a new life in the United States. After arriving in Kansas City, they meet Carrie Davis, an employment counselor who helps them find jobs and adjust to American culture. Despite facing unfamiliar customs, language barriers, and painful memories of their past, the refugees remain determined to build a better future and reunite with their separated sister. As Carrie becomes increasingly involved in their lives, she develops a deeper understanding of their extraordinary resilience and sacrifices. Starring Reese Witherspoon, Arnold Oceng, and Ger Duany, the film delivers powerful performances and emotional storytelling while exploring survival, immigration, family, compassion, sacrifice, and the enduring strength of the human spirit.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Melodrama

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 50m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Philippe Falardeau

✍️ Writer: Margaret Nagle

📚 Inspired By: The real-life experiences of the Lost Boys of Sudan.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: The Good Lie is a 2014 drama film written by Margaret Nagle and directed by Philippe Falardeau. The film stars Reese Witherspoon in the lead role, alongside Arnold Oceng, Ger Duany, Emmanuel Jal, and Corey Stoll. Witherspoon portrays a woman who helps four Sudanese refugees find jobs and adjust to life in the United States. The Good Lie was screened in the Special Presentations section of the 2014 Toronto International Film Festival before being released on October 3, 2014. Critical reception was largely positive. Another major screening was held by the Greenwich International Film Festival on October 22, 2014, for the benefit of the U.S. Fund for UNICEF.
